item.title: She's a contender to win Olympic gold. She says coming out is a big reason why.
item.description: Amber Glenn, a three-time U.S. champion figure skater, is a contender to medal in the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics, success she attributes in part to coming out as bisexual and pansexual.

item.title: Russian athletes to compete at the Milan Cortina Games, but not for Russia
item.description: For the second consecutive Olympic Games, no athletes will compete under the Russian flag

item.title: U.S. Olympic flag bearers are speedskater Erin Jackson and bobsledder Frank Del Duca
item.description: A speedskater from Florida who won Olympic gold in Beijing four years ago and a bobsledder from Maine making his second Olympic appearance will carry the U.S. flag at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics in Italy, officials announced Tuesday

item.title: Rory Guilday's long road from chemotherapy to the Olympics
item.description: It was decision day for the best U.S. women’s hockey players, and Rory Guilday was cautiously confident despite being cut from the team a year earlier.

item.title: In bobsled and speedskating, advanced AI offers Team USA an edge
item.description: In speedskating, tenths of a second can determine whether an athlete wins gold or misses out on medals entirely.

item.title: 'We love you Mom': Guthrie family asks for their mother's safe return
item.description: Savannah Guthrie and her siblings posted a statement on Instagram, pleading for the safe return of their mother, Nancy Guthrie, as the search for her continues on its fourth day.

item.title: Trump says his administration could use 'a softer touch' on immigration
item.description: President Donald Trump believes his administration could use “a softer touch” on immigration after federal agents killed two U.S. citizens in Minneapolis.

item.title: Trump says he'll stay out of the Netflix-Paramount fight over Warner Bros.
item.description: President Donald Trump said he plans to stay out of Netflix and Paramount Skydance’s battle over Warner Bros.

item.title: President Trump says nominee for Fed chair wants to lower interest rates
item.description: In an exclusive interview with Tom Llamas, President Trump says that Kevin Warsh would not have been picked for Federal Reserve chair if he was not in agreement with lowering interest rates.

item.title: President Trump talks Minneapolis, Joe Rogan, the Fed, AI and 2028 in a wide-ranging interview
item.description: In an exclusive interview with Tom Llamas, President Trump says he learned from Minneapolis that “maybe we could use a little bit of a softer touch. But you still have to be tough.” He also addressed the FBI raids on a Fulton County election center and his recent comments calling to ‘nationalize’ elections.
